Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we can coordinate with procurement:

- Suggested commercial path: POC on credit card (fast, minimal paperwork) -> Production on PO (standard for Acme) or via AWS Marketplace if you want single-pane procurement.
- Procurement asks identified: PO vs card agreement, tax docs (W-9), SOW + billing/contact for invoicing, and any legal redlines on our MSA.

Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (PO-friendly SOW + success criteria), pricing spreadsheet (in SOW PDF).

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll drop a W-9 and our standard MSA for review (see attachment follow-up).
2) Can you confirm whether procurement prefers PO or marketplace for production? If PO, please share the billing contact and purchase order template or expected timeline.
3) If helpful, David (cc'd) can run a quick technical handoff with your infra team next week to validate environment assumptions for the POC.

If there's a faster route for the POC (card + short SOW) we can start immediately - otherwise we'll plan for PO alignment and legal review.

Thanks,
